# Verdicts for .claude/hooks/block-dangerous-git.sh: "block" or "allow", a tab, then the command.
# A literal \n in a command stands for a newline (here-documents, line continuations).
# The R144 spellings come first (docs/tickets/review/issues/144-*.md); each was allowed before.
block	git clean -df
block	git clean -xdf
block	git checkout -- .
block	git restore -- .
block	git reset HEAD~1 --hard
block	git -C . reset --hard
block	git branch --delete --force x
block	git push origin --delete x
block	git push origin :x
block	git push -uf origin main
# Spellings blocked before, kept blocked.
block	git clean -fd
block	git checkout .
block	git restore .
block	git reset --hard
block	git branch -D x
block	git push -f
block	git push --force-with-lease
block	git push origin +main
# Other forms of the same operations.
block	git clean --force
block	git clean -f -x -d
block	git reset --hard origin/main
block	git -c core.pager=cat reset --hard
block	/usr/bin/git reset --hard
block	git branch -d x
block	git branch -Dr origin/x
block	git push --force origin main
block	git push origin main --force
block	git push --force-with-lease=main origin main
block	git push -d origin x
block	git push --mirror
block	git checkout -f main
block	git checkout HEAD -- :/
block	git restore --worktree --staged .
block	git restore --source=HEAD~1 .
block	git status && git reset --hard
block	git status; git clean -xdf
block	echo hi | git checkout -- .
block	bash -c "git reset --hard"
block	(cd packages && git clean -xdf)
block	FOO=1 git reset --hard
# Abbreviations git accepts, newer verbs, digit clusters and config that changes a verb (review of PR 57).
block	git reset --har
block	git push --force-with origin main
block	git push --del origin x
block	git push --mirr
block	git push --pru
block	git branch --del y
block	git clean --forc
block	git checkout --forc main
block	git switch -f main
block	git switch --force main
block	git switch --discard-changes main
block	git push -4f origin main
block	git --config-env core.x=HOME reset --hard
block	git -c alias.nk='push --force' nk origin main
block	git -c alias.nuke='branch -D' nuke z
block	git -c clean.requireForce=false clean
block	git -c remote.origin.push=+refs/heads/main:refs/heads/main push origin
block	git reset \\n--hard
block	git restore --staged --wor .
block	git checkout ./.
block	git checkout .//
block	git checkout -- $PWD
block	git checkout HEAD -- ':(top)'
block	echo --hard | xargs git reset
# Git that runs inside another command.
block	sh -c 'git push -f'
block	bash -lc "git clean -xdf"
block	eval "git reset --hard"
block	echo "$(git reset --hard)"
block	echo `git clean -fdx`
block	find . -name x -exec git checkout -- . \;
block	bash <<'EOF'\ngit reset --hard\nEOF
block	timeout 5 git push --force
block	sudo -u x git reset --hard
block	env -i git reset --hard
block	{ git reset --hard; }
block	if true; then git clean -fd; fi
# Shells fed by options, stdin, pipes, here-strings and process substitution (verification of PR 57).
block	bash -o pipefail -c 'git reset --hard'
block	bash -euo pipefail <<'EOF'\ngit reset --hard\nEOF
block	bash -c -- 'git reset --hard'
block	bash -s -- x <<'EOF'\ngit reset --hard\nEOF
block	echo git reset --hard | bash
block	cat <<'EOF' | bash\ngit reset --hard\nEOF
block	bash <<< 'git reset --hard'
block	bash <(echo git reset --hard)
block	ssh host 'git reset --hard'
block	node -e "require('child_process').execSync('git reset --hard')"
block	git submodule foreach 'git reset --hard'
# Wrappers the guard does not need to know by name.
block	xcrun git reset --hard
block	arch -arm64 git reset --hard
block	mise exec -- git reset --hard
block	script -q /dev/null git reset --hard
block	exec -a foo git reset --hard
block	env -P /usr/bin git reset --hard
block	sudo -D /tmp git reset --hard
block	eval -- 'git reset --hard'
block	function f { git reset --hard; }; f
block	coproc git reset --hard
block	watch -n 5 git reset --hard
block	nohup git reset --hard
block	command git reset --hard
block	env -S 'git reset --hard'
block	find . -execdir git reset --hard \;
block	git push --force-if-includes origin main
# Redirections, ANSI-C quoting, expansions and brace lists.
block	git 2>&1 reset --hard
block	git 2>/dev/null reset --hard
block	git </dev/null reset --hard
block	git &>/dev/null reset --hard
block	git 2>&1 push origin +main
block	$'git' reset --hard
block	git reset $'--hard'
block	git reset $"--hard"
block	git reset ${x:---hard}
block	git {reset,--hard}
block	git reset --{hard,}
block	git push origin $'+main'
block	git push -u origin "$(git branch --show-current)"
# Config that renames or loosens a verb, by variable or by git config.
block	GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=alias.nk GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0='reset --hard' git nk
block	GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS="'alias.nk=reset --hard'" git nk
block	git -c remote.origin.mirror=true push origin
block	git config alias.nk 'reset --hard' && git nk
block	git config clean.requireForce false && git clean -xd
# Whole-tree pathspecs by exclusion, expansion, glob or file.
block	git checkout -- ':!nothing'
block	git checkout -- ':(exclude)x'
block	git checkout -- "$PWD/"
block	git checkout -- "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
block	git restore '**'
block	git restore --pathspec-from-file=list.txt
# Text that only mentions a destructive command is not run, so it is allowed.
allow	git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'\nfix: the guard blocks git branch -D x\nEOF\n)"
allow	gh pr create --body "$(cat <<'EOF'\n1) never run git push -f\nEOF\n)"
allow	bash scripts/tests/git-guard.test.sh
allow	bash -c "bun run check"
allow	ssh host 'git status'
allow	git push -u origin HEAD
allow	git config user.name
allow	(( x = 1 << 2 ))\ngit status
allow	git commit -m "fix: describe git reset --hard"
allow	git commit -F - <<'EOF'\nfix: the guard blocks git branch -D x\nEOF
allow	gh pr create --body "never git push -f"
allow	grep -rn "git reset --hard" docs
allow	rg 'git checkout \.'
allow	echo "run git restore ."
allow	cat <<EOF > notes.txt\ngit clean -xdf\nEOF
allow	git log --grep="reset --hard"
allow	git status # git reset --hard
allow	git switch main
allow	git switch -c new-branch
allow	git push --follow-tags
allow	git push --no-verify
allow	git branch --list
# Everyday commands stay allowed.
allow	git status
allow	git push
allow	git push -u origin kit
allow	git push origin kit:kit
allow	git reset --soft HEAD~1
allow	git reset HEAD file.txt
allow	git clean -n
allow	git clean -nd
allow	git branch --show-current
allow	git branch -vv
allow	git checkout -b feature
allow	git checkout main
allow	git checkout -- packages/web/src/file.ts
allow	git restore packages/web/src/file.ts
allow	git restore --staged .
allow	git diff --stat
allow	git log --oneline -5
allow	git worktree list
allow	ls -la
allow	bun run check
